title: Not happy. Would not but again.
text: Not happy. Would not but again.. Dislike. Cheap just like the price. Can’t say you get what you pay for as I have purchased higher price kettles that don’t work long. This one is extremely light weight and so is the base. I lift the kettle off and the base flies off the table. The filter screen is so cheaply made it extends beyond filter like extra material that should have been trimmed. Not happy at all. So tired of buying items based on reviews that I doubt now.

product_metadata.title: Hamilton Beach 41038 Electric Tea Kettle, Water Boiler & Heater, Cordless Serving, Auto-Shutoff & Boil-Dry Protection, 1500 Watts for Fast Boiling, 1.7 Liter, Black
features: AUTOMATIC SHUTOFF FOR PEACE OF MIND: The automatic shutoff function turns the electric kettle off when water comes to a boil, and the boil-dry protection function keeps the kettle from scorching if the water level gets too low.

BPA-FREE INTERIOR: Whether you're boiling water for preparing hot beverages or making a quick batch of instant noodles or oatmeal, this tea kettle's interior is made of BPA-free material for confident, worry-free use.

35% FASTER BOILING THAN A MICROWAVE*: Rapidly bring water to boil so you can make yourself a quick cup of tea, hot cocoa or coffee without the long wait — perfect for hectic mornings or anytime you need hot water fast.

SIMPLE OPERATION: Just flip down the switch and walk away — you can boil water quickly without fussing with complicated controls. You'll always know when the electric tea kettle is on since the illuminated power switch turns off after water boils.

STYLISH AND FUNCTIONAL WATER WINDOW WITH METALLIC TRIM. With the attractive, easy-to-view water window, you'll always know how much water is in the kettle or how much water you're adding when refilling.
*As compared to a 1250W microwave boiling 28 oz. of water
